description: Thresholds + cadence for the Control Center alert engine. The DAILY refresh pulls lean account-level rows (1 per account) and runs the 'daily' rules — fast signal detection (CPA/ROAS/CTR/zero-conversion/health). The WEEKLY refresh pulls campaign-level rows (filtered to active/with-spend) and runs the 'weekly' rules — pacing, budget caps, per-campaign problems. Tune values here; no code changes needed. See build/evaluate.mjs.

cadences.daily: Account-level scan. Cheap (one row per account via account-level GAQL / Meta level=account). Powers fast signals: CPA/ROAS/CTR moves, zero-conversion spend, connection health.
cadences.weekly: Campaign-level deep scan. Heavier (filtered to ENABLED + cost>0 to stay small). Powers pacing, budget-cap detection, and per-campaign zero-conversion / high-CPA / non-delivery.

rules.desc: Account returns an auth/permission error (e.g. 403 USER_PERMISSION_DENIED). Downgraded to info when the client has another live platform.
Account status is not ACTIVE / disabled / billing hold.
Daily spend exceeds trailing 7-day average by more than threshold_pct (needs >=7 days history).
Daily spend falls below trailing 7-day average by more than threshold_pct.
Campaign daily spend at/above threshold_pct of its daily budget (scaling opportunity).
Month-to-date spend projects above threshold_pct of the monthly target.
Account CPA rises more than threshold_pct vs trailing baseline.
ROAS drops below threshold_ratio of the trailing 30-day baseline.
Purchase account running below 1.0 ROAS (spending more than it returns).
CTR falls below threshold_ratio of the trailing baseline (creative fatigue).
Account/campaign spent above min_spend with 0 conversions. Meta engagement objectives are downgraded to info.
Cost per lead/conversion exceeds the client-group median by more than this multiple (e.g. a Rola dealer vs the dealer-group median).
Campaign CPA exceeds the account's best/blended CPA by more than this multiple.
No rows / zero activity returned for longer than this many hours while campaigns are enabled.
Campaign is ACTIVE/ENABLED but recorded 0 impressions over the window.
